metas.name: ONE PIECE
metas.description:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.
Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.
*This includes the following special episodes:
- Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore! (Episode 336)
- The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle! (Episode 492)
- Team Formation! Save Chopper (Episode 542)
- History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (Episode 590)
- 20th Anniversary! Special Romance Dawn (Episode 907)

metas.name: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 4th Season
metas.description:
In the deadly battle at Priestella, Subaru and his allies emerged victorious, but at great cost. As Subaru searches for a way to save Rem, Crusch, and Julius, he learns of a "wise woman," Shaula, an all-seeing being said to possess every form of knowledge, who resides at the Pleiades Watchtower. Subaru and his crew must brave the uncharted Auguria Dunes to reclaim what was lost.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Lucca Comics & Games pre-screened episode 1 early on November 1, 2025, prior to the Japanese television broadcast on July 8th, 2026.

metas.name: Seihantai na Kimi to Boku 2nd Season
metas.description:
Six months have passed since the polar opposite classmates Miyu Suzuki and Yuusuke Tani started dating. Through spending time together along with their friends from school, the two have been happier than ever. As the year nears its end, the new couple plans to celebrate Christmas and the New Year together, making memories for years to come.

Meanwhile, Miyu and Yuusuke's friends Shuuji Taira and Kentarou Yamada are puzzled by their own situations. Due to his bad experiences in middle school, Taira still overthinks everything around him, especially after his classmate Shino Azuma began giving him more attention. Simultaneously, the usually energetic and outspoken Yamada finds it difficult to find the perfect time to confess his feelings to his shy schoolmate Natsumi Nishi. Despite everyone's differences, they continue enjoying their adolescence together and find their own ways to turn the winter break into a cherished memory.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

metas.name: Temppal: Item no Chikara
metas.description:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

metas.name: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru
metas.description:
Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season
metas.description:
The third season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru.

Note: On September 4, 2026, it was announced that GeyeG Pictures would take over the production from studio MOTHER while keeping the same staff.

metas.name: Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou
metas.description:
The war is over, but General Drel's secrets remain. As visitors from Hiden, Boelate, and Eslinn converge on Solsein, Boelate's divine academy, the search for Drel's hidden room begins. Among those drawn into the mystery is Klen, now serving as Luna's magic teacher. But what truth lies at the heart of Drel's secret?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season
metas.description: The second season of Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta!

metas.name: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
metas.description:
The second and third race stage of JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run.

In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide.. 

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

metas.name: Dogul Wang
metas.description:
Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo
metas.description:
Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke. However, her days as an archnoble in noble society are brutal, as she is put through rigorous etiquette and magic training on top of her duties as High Bishop and forewoman. It all proves too much for a weak little seven-year-old girl... Or it would have, had the High Priest not offered her the keys to the temple’s book room as a reward. If she could get her hands on those, she’d be able to read all sorts of precious books! Her name may have changed, but Rozemyne’s passion for books remains the same as she charges into a whole new world! The detailed setting expands as the printing industry grows in size. Here begins Part 3 of this biblio-fantasy for book lovers everywhere!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

metas.name: Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi 2nd Season
metas.description: The second season of Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi.

metas.name: BLEACH: Sennen Kessen-hen - Kashin-tan
metas.description:
Destruction looms at the end of the Thousand-Year Blood War between the Soul Reapers and Quincies… as the death of the Soul King mirrors the collapse of the Three Worlds, distortions and omens of destruction start to appear in all realms. 

Fierce battles erupt throughout the Wahr Welt between the Thirteen Court Guard Squads and the Royal Guard. Ichigo learns about Uryuu's true intentions and renews his determination to protect the world together, as friends who trust each other. Yhwach has surpassed even his own ability, The Almighty...

The fierce battle for the survival of the Three Worlds approaches its end. Beyond the chaos of calamity, what lies in wait—despair or hope?

(Source: VIZ Media, edited)

metas.name: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
metas.description:
After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Meitantei Conan
metas.description:
Kudo Shinichi is a seventeen year-old high school detective whom people call the "Modern Sherlock Holmes." However, one night after a date with his childhood sweetheart, Ran, Shinichi witnessed an illegal trade and, caught off his guard, was knocked unconscious and fed a drug that was supposed to kill him... but he woke up and found himself shrunken to a seven year-old. In order to track down the men who did this to him, Shinichi hid his identity and lived with Ran, whose father happened to be a hopeless detective, and with that came a series of murders and mysteries that he must solve. 
(Source: Anime News Network)

Note:
- Includes Keisatsu Gakkou-hen - Wild Police Story in episodes 1029, 1038, 1042, 1061
- Episodes 11, 52, 76, 118, 162, 184, 208, 342, 356, 449, 452, 487, 488, 489, 490, 515, 516, 521, 522, 651, 734, 804, 805, 927, 928, 1187 aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode.
- Episodes 96, 129, 174, 219, 263, 304, 383, 479 aired with a runtime of ~90 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode.
- Episode 345, 425 aired with a runtime of ~115 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode.

metas.name: Pocket Monsters (2023)
metas.description: A new dream and adventure set throughout the entire Pokémon world unfolds in a brand new Pokémon-series following a girl named Liko and a boy named Roy.

metas.name: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
metas.description:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.

metas.name: Shiguang Dailiren III
metas.description: The third season of Shiguang Dailiren.

metas.name: Xian Ni
metas.description:
It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid of the ants behind it. He firmly believed in human beings and entered the path of cultivation with mediocre qualifications. After experiencing ups and downs, with his wise mind, he gradually reached the pinnacle and became famous in the cultivation world with his own strength.

(Source: WeTV)

metas.name: Meitantei Precure!
metas.description:
The 23rd installment of the long-running Precure series.

Anna Akechi is a second-year junior high student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her 14th birthday, she has a chance encounter with a fairy named Pochitan, and a magical pendant caused her to travel back in time from 2027 to 1999! In the Makoto Mirai Town 28 years in the past, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a girl her age who wants to become a great detective.

Meanwhile, people in town are in trouble as their prized possessions are being stolen from under their noses - the cause being a group of Phantom Thieves. To stop them, Anna and Mikuru turn into Precures! Maybe if they solve these mysteries, Anna can find her way back to her own time?

(Source: Official Website, translated)

metas.name: Chiikawa
metas.description:
Meet Chiikawa and best friends Hachiware and Usagi as they navigate the ups and downs of everyday life in a world that's cute, fantastical and full of surprises. Together they work hard, enjoy tasty treats, face unexpected challenges, and find joy in the little things.

(Source: Chiikawa Official Youtube Channel)

metas.name: Doraemon (2005)
metas.description: A new Doraemon series produced by the same team as the 1979 series (in association with Studio Pierrot) with new voice actors and staff and updated character designs.

metas.name: Mu Shen Ji 4
metas.description: The fourth part of Mu Shen Ji.

metas.name: Crayon Shin-chan
metas.description:
Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.
Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home.
During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

metas.name: Ni Tian Zhizun
metas.description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

metas.name: Cheng Ye Xiao He
metas.description:
In the game, the server's top swordsman, Xiao Wujin, and the most wanted female outlaw, Tao Zhiyaoyao, first crossed paths as rivals. In real life, campus heartthrob Xiao He of Dongchuan University and freshman Shen Xin met through a collegiate esports tournament and quickly grew close. Together with their friend Yang Yao, they formed a team and fought their way through every challenge, determined to claim the championship. Along the way, Xiao He and Shen Xin healed and inspired one another, moving forward hand in hand in pursuit of their dreams. With a little help from their friends Yang Yao and Xiang Nan, what kind of romance will blossom between them?

(Source: iQ)

metas.name: Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen
metas.description:
The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Li Xiongmao
metas.description:
Adapted from a novel by Wen Zhou, this story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by demons who is sent by his master to leave Black-White Mountain and kill the three enemies responsible for the demons’ downfall. As he searches for the truth, he gradually unravels the mysteries behind the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and his own destiny.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

metas.name: Transformers: Wild King W
metas.description: A sequel to Transformers: Wild King.

metas.name: Umayuru: Full Gate!
metas.description: "Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!

metas.name: Holo no Graffiti
metas.description:
From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

metas.name: Zhe Tian
metas.description:
The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

(Source: Webnovel)

metas.name: Wushen Zhuzai: Da Wei Pian
metas.description: The second season of Wushen Zhuzai.

metas.name: Rilakkuma
metas.description:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!
(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! CARD GAME: THE CHRONICLES
metas.description:
Yu-Gi-Oh! CARD GAME THE CHRONICLES is a monthly short-anime series showcasing Official Card Game-original card themes. It is an expansion of the demo reel of the same name released the previous year.

Episodes and Themes

01-02: Sky Striker Ace
03-08: The Fallen & The Virtuous
09-12: Spirit Charmers
13-16: Magistus
17-21: Seeker of the Sinful Spoils

metas.name: Ganso! Bandori-chan
metas.description:
After taking the girls' band world by storm, "BanG Dream Chan" is back!?

Get ready for a huge reunion with all your favorite pop and cute band members in the fun-filled girls' band comedy!

Come on, BanG Dream Chan! We are all BanG Dream Chan!

(Source: BanG Dream! GBP Twitter account)

Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.

metas.name: Odekake Kozame Season 2
metas.description: Second season of Odekake Kozame.

metas.name: Koneko no Haitatsuin Uunyan
metas.description:
Today’s the day Unyan the kitten becomes a delivery courier! Getting dressed, eating breakfast, packing his bag…He’s eager to get started, but there are so many firsts along the way! It’s a busy morning for this little kitten courier!

(Source: YouTube)

metas.name: Yani Neko Mini
metas.description: Chibi shorts posted on the official  Yani Neko YouTube channel and Twitter account of the main series.

metas.name: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Kyuukei Jikan (Break Time) 4th Season
metas.description: The fourth season of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Kyuukei Jikan (Break Time).

metas.name: Guangyin Zhi Wai 2
metas.description: Second season of Guangyin Zhi Wai.

metas.name: You Shou Yan 6th Season
metas.description: The sixth season of You Shou Yan.

metas.name: Zeri Feisheng
metas.description: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...(Source: iQ)

metas.name: Zhangmen Didiao Dian
metas.description: As heavy snow blanketed the gates, demonic cultivators launched a surprise attack, slaughtering the entire Mo Sect. The young Lu Chaoge lost his closest relatives in the tragedy. Facing certain death, he awakened to a system that defied the heavens, narrowly escaping death through water-elemental spiritual awakening, and vowed to purge the world of demons and evil. After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.(Source: Yuewen, translated)

metas.name: Nintama Rantarou
metas.description:
Rantarou, Shinbei and Kirimaru are ninja apprentices in the Ninja Gakuen, where first grade ones are called "Nintamas" (contraction of the words ninja+tama (egg). They must learn everything a ninja must know, but as for our heroes, money, food or playing are more interesting. The series show the everyday adventures of our heroes, segmentated in a cartoon fashion, like 2 small episodes in a 30-min show. The cast also includes the teachers (Doi-sensei and crossdressing Yamada-sensei), nintama kunoichis, evil guys (Dokutake ninjas) and even family members of all the cast...

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Sore Ike! Anpanman
metas.description:
One night, a Star of Life falls down the chimney of a bakery nestled deep in the forest, causing the dough in the oven to come to life. The dough becomes Anpanman, a superhero made of anpan (a sweet roll with bean jam filling). Together with his friends, Anpanman fights his rival Baikinman and helps the malnourished.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Sazae-san
metas.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.

metas.name: Ojarumaru
metas.description:
In the Heian era, around 1000 years ago, a young boy of noble family named Ojarumaru is bored with his life of privilege. Meanwhile, three demons steal the power-stick of Enma, king of demons, and then lose it. Ojarumaru finds it, and uses it to transport himself to the present time. Here, he is befriended by a young boy named Kazuma, and becomes a member of his family. As time goes on, Ojarumaru makes many new friends, while dodging the comedic efforts of the three demons, Akane, Kisuke, and Aobee, as they try to recover the stick. 

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Chibi Maruko-chan (1995)
metas.description:
Momoko Sakura is an elementary school student who likes popular idol Momoe Yamaguchi and mangas. She is often called "Chibi Maruko-chan" due to her young age and small size. She lives together with her parents, her grandparents and her elder sister in a little town. In school, she has many friends with whom she studies and plays together everyday, including her close pal, Tama-chan; the student committee members, Maruo-kun and Migiwa-san; and the B-class trio: 'little master' Hanawa-kun, Hamaji-Bu Taro and Sekiguchi-kun. This is a fun-loving and enjoyable anime that portrays the simple things in life.

(Source: Anime News Network)
